# Umay Garment — Custom Fur & Faux Fur Garment OEM/ODM Factory

> Jiaxing Umay Garment Co., Ltd. supplies OEM/ODM real-fur, leather and faux-fur outerwear from Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China. This file separates supplier-stated capabilities from independently visible Alibaba.com platform signals.

## Company

- Company name: Jiaxing Umay Garment Co., Ltd.
- Location: Jiaxing, Zhejiang Province, China
- Experience: The supplier's Alibaba product content states 20+ years in the garment industry; request dated business or production records when this is material to vendor approval.
- Platform status: Alibaba publicly shows 1 year on Alibaba.com, Trade Assurance/order protection and an onsite/legal-status verification signal. The Alibaba company card classifies the supplier as a Trading Company, while supplier-written content states it has its own factory; buyers should verify the operating entity and production site during qualification.

## Product Categories

- [Genuine Leather Jackets](https://www.umaygarment.com/products/leather-jacket): Cowhide, lambskin and sheepskin jackets with optional fur details.
- [Custom Sheepskin Leather Lace-Up Halter Top — UMERL3101](https://www.umaygarment.com/products/custom-sheepskin-leather-halter-top): A cropped leather halter-top style family shown in leopard, snake, black and coffee directions; measurements, material finish and commercial terms are confirmed for each project.
- [Faux Fur Coats](https://www.umaygarment.com/products/faux-fur): Long-pile, short-pile and teddy faux-fur outerwear; fiber composition and color are confirmed per style.

## Leather Halter Top Reference

- The user-supplied Alibaba pages 1601919150790 and 1601919201250 publicly show the same UMAY model number, UMERL3101, and closely matched attributes. The independent site consolidates them into one product family to avoid duplicate pages.
- Public attributes checked August 21, 2026: real sheepskin leather, cropped and collarless halter silhouette, front lace-up detail, and black, dark coffee, light coffee, leopard and snake directions.
- Alibaba prices, platform MOQ, visible size selections, freight estimates and availability are not treated as fixed independent-site terms. Obtain a current written quotation for the final specification.

## Key Business Facts

- MOQ: The two linked Alibaba product pages publicly show 2 pieces for the listed variants. Care-label and main-label customization is shown from 50 pieces. MOQ varies by material, color, label, size mix and design change.
- Samples: Both linked Alibaba products display “7 days sample order lead time” support. Actual sample charge and calendar schedule require written confirmation.
- Bulk lead time: Confirm after sample approval, quantity, material reservation and shipping method are fixed.
- Customization shown on Alibaba: color, clothing length, size/measurements, care label and main label; supplier content also describes OEM/ODM design and packaging support.
- Quality control: Supplier-written Alibaba content states raw-material control, multi-step inspection and 100% finished-garment inspection. Request the current QC checklist, inspection photos and acceptance standard for the order.
- Shipping: Courier, air and sea options depend on destination, quantity and product restrictions; confirm Incoterm, documentation and landed-cost responsibility in writing.

## FAQ

- Q: What is your MOQ? A: Public Alibaba references for SKUs 1601898292176 and 1601905773109 show 2 pieces for the listed variants. Custom labels are shown from 50 pieces; reconfirm the MOQ for the final specification.
- Q: Do you provide samples before bulk production? A: Alibaba displays 7-day sample-order lead-time support on the two linked products. Sample charge, materials and actual schedule are confirmed after specification review.
- Q: Can you customize material, color, size and logo? A: Alibaba lists color, clothing-length, care-label and main-label options. Other OEM/ODM changes are subject to feasibility, sampling and written approval.
- Q: What materials do you offer? A: The website shows real fox fur, real raccoon fur, genuine leather, cashmere/shearling, Mongolian lamb and synthetic faux-fur categories. Confirm the exact species or fiber composition, grade and labeling for each order.
- Q: What is your production lead time? A: It varies by material, sample approval, quantity and shipping plan; obtain the current dates in the proforma invoice or order contract.
- Q: How do you control quality? A: Supplier content describes raw-material control and 100% finished-garment inspection. Buyers should attach a style-specific QC checklist, tolerance and defect standard to the order.
- Q: How do you ship internationally? A: Courier, air and sea options may be available. Confirm Incoterm, species/material documents, freight quote, destination requirements and tracking before payment.
- Q: Do you offer faux-fur options? A: A faux-fur collection is shown on the website. Confirm fiber composition, labeling and market-specific claims rather than using an unqualified “eco-friendly” or “vegan” claim.
